onboarding.entrySubtitle: Create a new wallet or import an existing one. Private keys and mnemonics stay encrypted on this device.
onboarding.createBody: The app will generate a new mnemonic and derive default EVM, Bitcoin, Tron, Solana, and Sui addresses.
onboarding.riskLoss: A lost mnemonic means the wallet cannot be recovered
onboarding.riskResponsibility: Keep your mnemonic yourself. Anyone with it can control your assets, and the app cannot restore or freeze the wallet for you.
onboarding.riskNoBackupGate: The MVP does not require backup verification, but you must understand the risk before entering the wallet.
onboarding.importBody: Import with a mnemonic, EVM private key, Bitcoin private key, Tron private key, Solana private key, or Sui suiprivkey. The material is encrypted after you set a password.
onboarding.importPrivateKeyWalletDescription: EVM, Bitcoin, Tron, Solana, or Sui wallet
onboarding.mnemonicHint: Enter your mnemonic, 12 or 24 words separated by spaces
onboarding.mnemonicImportHint: Enter a mnemonic to import an existing wallet
onboarding.privateKeyHint: EVM hex, Bitcoin WIF/hex, Solana private key, or Sui suiprivkey
onboarding.setPasswordBody: This password unlocks the local wallet and encrypts wallet data. If you forget it, you must re-import your mnemonic or private key.

about.title: About
about.openLinkFailed: Unable to open the link. Please try again.
about.checkUpdateFailed: Unable to check for updates. Please try again.
about.latestVersionBody: The installed version is already the latest version.
about.noReleaseBody: There is no public stable release available on GitHub yet.
about.releaseNotesEmpty: No release notes were provided for this version.
about.dataLocalBody: Mnemonics and private keys are encrypted and stored on this device. Safe Wallet cannot recover your mnemonic, private key, or wallet password.
about.backendBody: Safe Wallet does not depend on a proprietary account system or private backend. Assets, transactions, and on-chain operations are requested directly through your selected RPC nodes.
about.servicesBody: Depending on the feature, the app may access RPC nodes, Chainlist, CoinGecko, DefiLlama, Jupiter, DexScreener, Frankfurter, and GitHub. Third-party dApps and services are governed by their own privacy policies.
about.analyticsBody: This version does not include advertising, behavioral analytics, or crash-reporting SDKs. dApps, RPC nodes, and third-party data services may independently log network requests.
about.privacyLocalBody: Wallet keys, wallet accounts, and address book data are stored on this device. Sensitive key material is encrypted.
about.privacyNetworkBody: The app sends necessary requests to selected RPC nodes and public data services to retrieve balances, prices, transaction status, network configuration, and update information.
about.privacyNoAnalyticsBody: This version does not include advertising or behavioral analytics SDKs and does not upload mnemonics, private keys, or wallet passwords to a Safe Wallet server.
about.privacyThirdPartyBody: When using dApps, RPC nodes, or third-party data services, those providers may process IP addresses, wallet addresses, and request content under their own privacy policies.
about.privacyChangeBody: This notice will be updated if data handling changes in a future release.
about.termsSelfCustodyBody: Safe Wallet is a self-custody wallet. You are responsible for protecting your mnemonic, private keys, and wallet password. The developer cannot recover them.
about.termsTransactionBody: Blockchain transactions are generally irreversible. Verify the address, network, amount, and fee before submitting.
about.termsRiskBody: Digital assets and on-chain applications involve risk. Information in the app is not investment, legal, or tax advice.
about.termsThirdPartyBody: RPC nodes, dApps, tokens, and third-party services are operated by their respective providers. Safe Wallet does not control their availability or content.
about.termsWarrantyBody: The software is provided as-is. To the extent permitted by applicable law, you assume the risks of using it.
